description: Search full-release browser games by title or gameplay. Returns canonical play-page links and related primary guides. Empty query lists games alphabetically; results do not represent popularity.

category.description: Exact catalog category, e.g. puzzle, card, board, clicker.

device.description: A supported device listed by the game publisher; not a guarantee for every browser.

query.description: Words from the game title, genre or gameplay, e.g. sudoku, idle, rngdle, size it up.

name: search_games
title: Search FoolFish games
